comment: Turns the New Relic reporting integration on or off.
modal: When **Yes**, the New Relic reporting integration is active; **No** disables it. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Enables the scheduled job that reports data to New Relic.
modal: When **Yes**, the cron job that collects and sends reporting data to New Relic runs on its schedule; **No** stops it. Can be set per website or store view.
